turns.agent:
The connected Magic Hour tools don’t support **resize-and-pad without regeneration**, so I can’t create those three files here while respecting your instructions. I won’t use an AI editor to redraw your poster.

This Pillow script creates all three locally, keeping the **entire poster visible**, centered on cream padding, with no cropping or AI generation:

```python
from PIL import Image, ImageOps

poster = ImageOps.exif_transpose(Image.open("v4-poster.jpg")).convert("RGB")

outputs = {
    "poster-feed-1x1.png": (1080, 1080),
    "poster-story-9x16.png": (1080, 1920),
    "poster-banner-16x9.png": (1920, 1080),
}

for filename, size in outputs.items():
    fitted = ImageOps.contain(poster, size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", size, "#E8DFC5")
    canvas.paste(
        fitted,
        ((size[0] - fitted.width) // 2, (size[1] - fitted.height) // 2),
    )
    canvas.save(filename)
```

Run `pip install Pillow` first, then run the script in the same folder as `v4-poster.jpg`.
